$comment: The 'Beyond the Numbers' method (homepage and About). Approved claims: PS-01 theme, PS-02 four stages, PS-04 stage descriptions, PS-07 statement, PS-08 'In practice' examples. Every example traces to approved services or work history; no client names or outcome claims.
statement: Clean books are the start; understanding them is the point.

stages.name: Understand
stages.description: Learn the business, its processes and its records before touching the numbers.
stages.practice: Before taking over a client's books, I review how they sell, get paid and spend, then fit the chart of accounts to how the business actually works.

stages.name: Reconcile
stages.description: Make the records agree with bank statements, invoices and other source evidence.
stages.practice: Every month, bank, card and loan accounts are reconciled to statements. For online sellers, marketplace payouts are split into sales, fees, refunds and reserves.

stages.name: Analyze
stages.description: Turn accurate records into a clear view of performance, costs and cash.
stages.practice: Monthly reports include month-over-month variance notes and budget vs. actual, so owners see what moved and why.

stages.name: Improve
stages.description: Recommend and help put in place better processes and controls.
stages.practice: I rebuilt the books of a Dubai subsidiary and set up its accounting system. For clients today, bill approval workflows mean nothing is paid until the owner approves it.
